notes.content:
This is probably the last push before demo. 
  
Added a new enemy called Urchin. A few of them automatically spawn in the first sector.

First Tutorial final fight more likely to kill you now.
    
Added Camera and Zoom Sensitivity. You should be able to adjust them both in-game and at the main menu.  
  
Cleaned up menus in general.

After no Rifts are detected, an indicator will now be added to enemies to help you clean up stragglers.
   
Made some changes to Plasma Projectiles.  
  
Various bug fixes.  
  
Trying to clean up UI. Let me know if a UI element seems to be the wrong size or in a weird place.
  
Hugs and kisses, 
Andrew

notes.title: Update 12/13/2024
notes.content:
Updated:
  
The big planets in the background now move when you change sectors.
    
The boss now has more appropriate health. It should be nearly impossible to kill with weapon damage alone.

Made enemies smarter and faster. They will now randomly break off pursuit which makes them impossible to corral. Most enemy projectiles now have mild tracking. 
  
An objective indicator will now fire toward offscreen objectives.

Fixed "trim" issue causing Laika and EvenTide to drift off of a straight course.  
  
Made some tweaks to how the music system works as I perpare to polish that off.

notes.title: Update 10/29/24
notes.content:
Added rearview (RMB or Up Arrow) and side cams (left and right arrow)

(hopefully) Fixed an issue with mouse locking on multiple monitor setups.

I am preparing a demo for steam next fest in february. It will include three playable ships. Please try them out and mess around with their special abilities (C).

Upgrades for these ships are incomplete, I will be working on that.
